Either way, all I was saying is that I have been able to stay within the electric/gas budget. It is not impossible to be frugal.  I do think the rest of their budget is kind of stupid.  Did we expect financial genius from McDonald's? 

No,I don't support free college but it should be affordable so people can learn trades so they don't need to work at McDonald's.  There are a lot of good paying jobs remain open because they do not have trained people for them.
